limitations: Mosaic Desk, corpus units, candidate paths, contexts, outputs, metrics, and diagnoses are fictional and synthetic.
The retrieval fixture uses declared candidate lists and proves no embedding, index, reranker, latency, or quality result.
The assembly fixture uses synthetic teaching units and does not prove token-position behavior, citation entailment, source truth, or security sufficiency.
The joint-evaluation fixture proves branching mechanics only; its classifications are not representative measurements or causal certainty.
Figure records are semantic anchors only; root owns ImageGen production.
